summary.name: Minimalist Product Motion Design
summary.visualIdentity: A normalized product presentation direction: one accurately represented product, a few meaningful details, generous space, concise copy, precise proportions, and restrained materials and light. It is descriptive, not a historical movement.
summary.suitableUses: Suited by inference to premium product launches, hero reveals, detail views, spec callouts, and closing taglines. For interactive HTML, a centered hero or scroll-linked reveal can preserve the same focus and restraint.
summary.limitations: Keep the product and its brand colors accurate; adapt presentation principles without copying campaign shots. Avoid clutter, theatrical props, text over the product silhouette, and unsupported motion references. The palette example is not canonical.
summary.palette: Preserve supplied, brand, reference, and asset colors exactly. The optional fallback for new presentation elements is a discrete warm-white #F6F2EA background and charcoal #2A3030 foreground; no gradient. These are suggestions, not intrinsic style colors. Check contrast in the final composite.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Use smooth close-ups, selective reveals, purposeful detail or camera moves, and deliberate settling; keep motion restrained and copy readable. Video state must be deterministic and seekable. Optional references, only when supported by the actual scene, include a clean chapter handoff, component reveal, or subtle letter drift. For HTML, scroll-linked reveals and a lightbox are possible; provide reduced-motion behavior and usable navigation.
summary.audio: No fixed genre, tempo, voice, or audio layer is specified. Choose music, narration, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied choices and assets. Do not assume beat synchronization without measured audio.
summary.assetRequirements: Use available product imagery or geometry and exact copy where supplied; inspect accuracy, framing, and motion margins. SVG can provide crisp interface shapes, strokes, and masks; Blender can model, light, animate, and prerender genuine 3D products. Cropping tools prepare framing but cannot create missing artwork or extract subjects.
summary.combinations: Usually strongest alone. Optional style-104 adds axial symmetry and frontal hero framing without extra props or colors. Optional style-093 adds a few short spec lines, one moving line at a time, kept clear of the product; avoid expressive spring or scale motion on text.
summary.productionApproach: Select the visual renderer and motion engine for the assets and required fidelity; keep each animated property to one owner. Use shared composition time for reproducible states. HyperFrames owns assembly, timing, synchronization, validation, and export; Remotion is a fallback only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation requires it. Optional gallery, crop, color, or interaction tools do not define the style.
